title: Date(y,m,d), new Integer(int), and Runtime.exec(String) are deprecated-for-removal — modernize to java.time / valueOf / ProcessBuilder
notes: Three deprecated-for-removal APIs in one class: the Date(year-1900, month-0-based, day) constructor (the 1900 offset and 0-based month semantics must be preserved when moving to LocalDate), the new Integer(int) boxing constructor (use Integer.valueOf), and Runtime.exec(String) (use the String[] overload / ProcessBuilder to avoid the naive-split shell-quoting change).
